answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: each participant must complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings before issuing a proof. Cloning identities provides no proportional speedup, because the dependency chain resists parallel execution across GPUs; every forged node incurs the same wall-clock delay. Thus the kernel is a strict physical bottleneck, and neither a haven nor a voyage of simulated agents can evade it.
